summary: OpenHabitTracker is a self-hosted tool designed for logging daily habits, managing tasks, and recording notes. It incorporates time tracking, a calendar interface, and analytics to review completion statistics over time.
goodFor: Users who want a private, containerised application to monitor personal routines and productivity metrics without relying on third-party SaaS services.
watchOut: With a relatively small community and modest repository activity, you may encounter edge cases or lack integration options compared to more mature alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
